Title: Marker Desktop
Subtitle: Turn documents into structured content. Entirely on this PC.
Empty: Add PDF documents or images to begin.
ForceHelp: Use when embedded text is broken. Slower; may change correctly extracted text.
DisableHelp: Use embedded PDF text only. Scanned text and image equations may be omitted.
StripHelp: Re-read pages with an existing hidden OCR text layer.
DebugHelp: Save intermediate page images and layout details with the results.
LocalNotice: Models are included. No API key, account, or internet connection is needed. OCR on CPU may take time.
MissingEngine: The offline engine is missing. Install the complete offline package.
ChooseInput: Add at least one PDF or image.
InvalidRange: Page range must use zero-based numbers, for example 0,2-5.
PagesHelp: Leave blank for all pages. Example: 0,2-5. Applied to every file in the list.
ConfirmExit: Conversion is running. Cancel it and close?
NoExternalLlm: External LLM correction is not enabled in this offline edition.
CpuWarning: Balanced mode uses more OCR and is usually slower on CPU.
CompleteWithErrors: Finished with errors. See the activity log.
